scheme_name: Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education
other_conditions: Applicant must be an ex‑serviceman of rank Havildar or below, or his widow/dependent
Applicant must be pursuing a vocational or technical education course included in the Prime Minister Scholarship Scheme (PMSS)
Applicant must not be receiving benefits under the Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme or any other scholarship scheme
Applicant must have passed the previous academic year; failure results in cancellation of the scholarship
Scholarship is not payable to more than two children of the same ex‑serviceman
Scholarship is not admissible for battle casualty/disability or physical casualty cases
Only 50 students are selected each year based on merit
Scholarship continues for the duration of the course subject to annual renewal
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹15,000 per year per student, disbursed online to the beneficiary’s bank account.
documents_required: Original marks sheet (required for annual renewal)
